Author: Saddlebag Exchange
Name: Saddlebag Exchange
Description: Advanced marketboard tools and cross-world arbitrage scanning.
Changelog:
First public Dalamud listing for Saddlebag Exchange — the in-game companion to saddlebagexchange.com for marketboard analytics and gil-focused trading.

Tools include reselling search, marketshare analysis (with treemap), crafting profitability (craftsim), and shopping list workflows backed by live market data.

Open the window with /sbex, /saddlebag, or /saddlebagexchange, or from the Dalamud plugin menu.
